Nia (AE): Heads-up: RegulaCorp needs a short POC but legal insists on strict EU processing (including Norway/eu-north). They also want a list of subprocessors and a config snippet to show pinned routing + explicit fail behavior. Can we scope?
Tom (Solutions): Yep. Hosted endpoints can be region-specific. For strict EU-only we can pin to eu-west1, eu-central1, eu-north1 and set fallback: none so requests fail if capacity missing.
Tom (Solutions): Need expected qps and avg tokens to estimate cost impact.
Nia (AE): They plan ~35 r/s, avg 120 tokens. No BYOK for this POC.
Ruth (Legal): I'll prepare the subproc roster. Note: RegulaCorp also asked about Switzerland data routing — clarify that CH is not in the EU; we should state clearly what regions are considered "EU-only" for this engagement.
Evan (SRE): Technical points: data plane (inference) can be kept in pinned regions. Edge caches in eu-west1/eu-central1 may replicate small routing metadata within EU. Control-plane metrics are in our US control plane by default; we can document that they're operational telemetry only.
Tom (Solutions): Example snippet we can hand them:
```
routing:
  mode: geo_pin
  regions: [eu-west1, eu-central1, eu-north1]
  fallback: none   # fail-closed: return 429/503 when pinned regions exhausted
  cache_scope: regional
  telemetry: minimal
```
Ruth (Legal): Draft language: "Inference payloads and model execution will occur only in pinned EU regions. Control-plane operational telemetry (routing health, anonymized metrics and request hashes) may be processed outside the EU; no full payloads or customer PII will be transmitted." I'll add CH note.
Nia (AE): Timeline: customer wants subproc list + config + a one-line cost delta estimate by tomorrow morning. Can we do that?
Evan (SRE): I can deliver network path + cost uplift estimate. For their profile expect ~10-16% cost increase due to reduced packing across zones. Also note added latency variability for eu-north1.
Ruth (Legal): I'll upload subproc CSV and a compliance paragraph. Also will request RegulaCorp accept fail-closed behavior in the riser SOW.
infra-bot: Ticket PRESALES-4721 created. Owner: Evan (SRE). ETA: 36h.
Tom (Solutions): I'll prepare a small runbook with curl examples and a retry/backoff recommendation (3 retries, exponential).
Nia (AE): Great — I'll bundle the packet and send to RegulaCorp for review. Will post back when signed. :white_check_mark:
